def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):

    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
inp,out=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
# find block color (most common nonzero), marker color
from collections import Counter
c=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r if v)
print(c)
block=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
marker=[k for k in c if k!=block][0]
cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==block]
rs=[i for i,_ in cells]; cs=[j for _,j in cells]
r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
print(r0,r1,c0,c1)
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r if v)
    block=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=[k for k in c if k!=block][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==block]
    rs=[i for i,_ in cells]; cs=[j for _,j in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        row=g[i]
        mr=[j for j in range(W) if row[j]==marker]
        left = all(j>c1 for j in mr)  # marker right -> extend left
        right= all(j<c0 for j in mr)
        if left:
            for j in range(0,c0): out[i][j]=block
        if right:
            for j in range(c1+1,W): out[i][j]=block
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        col=[g[i][j] for i in range(H)]
        mc=[i for i in range(H) if col[i]==marker]
        up  = all(i>r1 for i in mc)
        down= all(i<r0 for i in mc)
        if up:
            for i in range(0,r0): out[i][j]=block
        if down:
            for i in range(r1+1,H): out[i][j]=block
    return out
pred=solve(inp)
print(pred==out)
if pred!=out:
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(pred,out)):
        if a!=b: print(i,a,b)

    """The distinct nonzero colors of the grid, most frequent first."""
    from collections import Counter
    return [v for v, _ in Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v).most_common()]

def rect(grid, color):
    """The bounding rectangle (top, left, bottom, right) of the cells of color."""
    cs=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==color]
    rs=[i for i,_ in cs]; js=[j for _,j in cs]
    return min(rs),min(js),max(rs),max(js)

def ray_line(grid, color, marker):
    """The solid rectangle of color extends along each of its rows toward the side
    of the row with no marker, and along each of its columns toward the side of the
    column with no marker (a marker on a side blocks that direction); other cells keep."""
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    r0,c0,r1,c1=rect(grid,color)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        ms=[j for j in range(W) if grid[i][j]==marker]
        if all(j>c1 for j in ms):
            for j in range(c0): out[i][j]=color
        if all(j<c0 for j in ms):

    for j in range(c0,c1+1):

        if all(i>r1 for i in ms):
            for i in range(r0): out[i][j]=color
        if all(i<r0 for i in ms):
            for i in range(r1+1,H): out[i][j]=color
    return out
